title: Choosing a Capstone Track
description: A three-branch decision tree that helps students choose among a Secure System, Security Program, or Applied Research capstone, with hover tooltips showing the estimated weeks of effort for each deliverable.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Distinguish the three capstone tracks by their guiding question and deliverables.
Estimate the effort each track requires from its deliverable timeline.
Match a personal interest in security work to an appropriate capstone track.
educational.prerequisites: None; intended as an orientation aid for capstone planning.

pedagogical.interaction: Hover or tap each deliverable to reveal its estimated weeks of effort.
pedagogical.assessment: Lesson plan asks students to justify a track choice from the deliverables.
pedagogical.misconceptions: Counters the idea that one track is 'easier' by showing all satisfy ABET Outcomes 1-6.
